// why: The vendored medprotocol CLI, typechecked on the terms of the repository it was copied
from rather than on this one's. See the note in tsconfig.json: the only difference is
`noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, which upstream does not set and which accounts for every one
of the 24 errors a copy otherwise raises. Relaxing it here keeps the copy a copy.
What is deliberately NOT relaxed is `verbatimModuleSyntax`. Node runs this CLI by
stripping its types, so a type imported without `import type` is a module that throws at
startup — two such imports existed in the copied source and this is what found them.
Anyone re-syncing the vendor directory should expect to fix that class again and nothing
